exceptions.evidence: KirinDesk web uses BrowserRouter declarative mode and does not import unstable RSC APIs. The advisory explicitly applies only to unstable RSC action handling. The registry has no react-router-dom 8.3.0 release as of 2026-07-30; the lockfile uses 7.18.2, which patches all published high advisories applicable to declarative mode.
exceptions.remediation: Remove this exception immediately when a published React Router release patches GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 on the supported declarative-mode line, or before enabling any RSC API.
